pairs: May fraternal charity remain in you.
And do not be willing to forget hospitality.
For by it, certain persons, without realizing it,
just as if you were imprisoned with them,
tamquam et ipsi in corpore morantes.
just as if you were in their place.
May marriage be honorable in every way,
and may the marriage bed be immaculate.
Let your behavior be without avarice;
be content with what you are offered.

So then, we may confidently say,
non timebo quid faciat mihi homo.
I will not fear what man can do to me.”

who have spoken the Word of God to you,
by observing the goal of their way of life:
Doctrinis variis et peregrinis nolite abduci.
Do not be led away by changing or strange doctrines.
Optimum est enim gratia stabilire cor,
And it is best for the heart to be sustained by grace,
quæ non profuerunt ambulantibus in eis.
For the latter have not been as useful to those who walked by them.

those who serve in the tabernacle have no authority to eat from it.
Quorum enim animalium infertur sanguis pro peccato in Sancta per pontificem,
For the bodies of those animals whose blood is carried into the Holy of holies by the high priest,
on behalf of sin, are burned outside the camp.
ut sanctificaret per suum sanguinem populum,
in order to sanctify the people by his own blood,
Exeamus igitur ad eum extra castra,
And so, let us go forth to him,
outside the camp, bearing his reproach.
Non enim habemus hic manentem civitatem,
For in this place, we have no everlasting city; instead,
we seek one in the future.
Per ipsum ergo offeramus hostiam laudis semper Deo,
Therefore, through him, let us offer the sacrifice of continual praise to God,
id est, fructum labiorum confitentium nomini ejus.
which is the fruit of lips confessing his name.
Beneficentiæ autem et communionis nolite oblivisci:
But do not be willing to forget good works and fellowship.
For God is deserving of such sacrifices.
Obedite præpositis vestris, et subjacete eis.
Obey your leaders and be subject to them.
Ipsi enim pervigilant quasi rationem pro animabus vestris reddituri,
For they watch over you, as if to render an account of your souls. So then,
may they do this with joy,
Otherwise, it would not be as helpful to you.
confidimus enim quia bonam conscientiam habemus in omnibus bene volentes conversari.
For we trust that we have a good conscience, being willing to conduct ourselves well in all things.
Amplius autem deprecor vos hoc facere,
And I beg you, all the more, to do this,
so that I may be quickly returned to you.
Then may the God of peace,
qui eduxit de mortuis pastorem magnum ovium,
who led back from the dead that great Pastor of sheep,
with the blood of the eternal testament,
so that you may do his will.
faciens in vobis quod placeat coram se per Jesum Christum:
May he accomplish in you whatever is pleasing in his sight, through Jesus Christ,
cui est gloria in sæcula sæculorum.
to whom is glory forever and ever.
